review_notes: I read the whole file and grepped Mathlib for other free presheaf-of-modules constructions (freeObj, PresheafOfModules.free, freeAdjunction). The only users are Presheaf/Generator.lean, which builds on this file, and Topology/Basic.lean, which defines an unrelated TopModuleCat free functor. ModuleCat.free, freeMk, freeDesc and freeHomEquiv in Adjunctions.lean are reused here pointwise, not redefined. The sheaf-level `free` in Sheaf/Free.lean is indexed by a type I and built as a coproduct of units. It is a different concept from the free presheaf on a presheaf of types, so I do not count it as a competitor. The names freeHomEquiv and freeAdjunction are the usual adjunction API. I found no avoidable competing definition.
